# ibisPaint

> > ibisPaint is a social drawing app for creating manga, illustrations, and digital art with a community gallery, animation features, and drawing process videos.

Developed by ibis inc., ibisPaint (also known as ibisPaint X) provides digital artists with tools including Screen Tone, Frame Divider, Text input, and Brush QR Code sharing. The platform features an IB-CC (Ibis Creative Commons) license for artwork sharing and integrates with social platforms like X, Facebook, and LINE for community engagement.

## Key Topics

- ibisPaint X
- Digital art creation
- Manga drawing tools
- Screen Tone
- Frame Divider
- Brush QR Code

- ibisAccount

- Text input tool
